rationale: Restore the reviewed safety default on the asset-retraction agent. Seed 446 (recorded 2026-08-20) ships the retract step with NO dry_run key — retract_asset_files' compiled default is dry-run TRUE, per the 2026-08-02 §2 unsafe-side-defaults-OFF ruling the action's own header cites. An operator edit (the staged gaswholesalers script's documented fallback for unverified step_overrides propagation: 'a one-off agent_definitions config UPDATE, snapshot first') left the LIVE row armed with "dry_run": false — snapshot taken 2026-08-20 17:31, never reverted — while the step's own description field still says 'dry run unless the step config carries dry_run:false'. Measured consequence 2026-08-22: ten dispatches intended as dry runs each deleted their target file on the first pass (the outcome was the owner-authorised end state for exactly those files, protected by a pre-dispatch estate-wide reference audit and the action's five-guard chain, which ran on every dispatch with 0 refusals — but the audit pass the dispatcher believed in did not exist). Migration 554 deletes the key so the compiled default governs again; an armed run once more requires the explicit literal. Pre-state guarded on the exact armed shape (a concurrent edit aborts), row backed up (bak_asset_retraction_20260822), verify block is DO/RAISE. All 13 stale-logo retractions the armed state enabled are complete and wire-verified, so nothing in flight depends on it. Applied and recorded 2026-08-22 (review after the fact by design, per the 2026-07-29 ruling); the prospective control is the LANDMINES entry added the same hour ('the asset-retraction agent's dry run by default was a LIE for two days'), and the incident is in WRONG_CALLS.md.
